invariants.description: The landing page must be fully responsive across devices.
invariants.enforcement: Use Tailwind responsive classes and test on multiple viewports.

invariants.description: All interactive elements must have accessible labels.
invariants.enforcement: Use aria-label attributes and semantic HTML.

invariants.description: The color palette must maintain a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 for text.
invariants.enforcement: Use Tailwind color utilities and verify with contrast checker.

invariants.description: Animations must not cause motion sickness; respect prefers-reduced-motion.
